info.title: Queue OpenAPI for hitem3d/hi3d/texture
info.description: The OpenAPI schema for the hitem3d/hi3d/texture queue.

x-fal-metadata.about:
Texture an existing geometry mesh using a reference image.

Staged generation: pass the GLB geometry produced by the
image-to-3d endpoint (enable_texture=false) together with the
reference image. Only v1.5 models support this task.

model.title: Model
model.description: Model version used for texturing. Only v1.5 models support the staged texture task.

enable_safety_checker.title: Enable Safety Checker
enable_safety_checker.description: If set to true, input images are checked for safety before processing.

mesh_url.title: Mesh Url
mesh_url.description: URL of the geometry model to texture. Only GLB format is supported (e.g. the geometry output of the image-to-3d endpoint with enable_texture=false).

image_url.title: Image Url
image_url.description: URL of the reference image used to texture the model. PNG, JPEG and WebP formats are supported, up to 20MB.

export_format.title: Export Format
export_format.description: File format of the generated model.

resolution.title: Resolution
resolution.description: Texture generation resolution. hitem3dv1.5 accepts 512, 1024, 1536 and 1536pro; scene-portraitv1.5 accepts 1536. Defaults to the model's recommended resolution.

Hi3dTextureInput.title: TextureInput
Hi3dTextureInput.description: Input for the staged texture task (texture an existing geometry mesh).

thumbnail.description: Preview image of the generated model, when available.

Hi3dTextureOutput.title: Hitem3DOutput
Hi3dTextureOutput.description: Output of the 3D model generation endpoints.

file_name.title: File Name
file_name.description: The name of the file. It will be auto-generated if not provided.

file_size.title: File Size
file_size.description: The size of the file in bytes.

content_type.title: Content Type
content_type.description: The mime type of the file.

url.title: Url
url.description: The URL where the file can be downloaded from.

schema.description: Whether to include logs (`1`) in the response or not (`0`).

success.description: Whether the request was cancelled successfully.
